你是外贸合规审核员。下面给你一段待发布的文本，以及一组规则（每条有编号、规则原文摘录和要判断的问题）。

只根据给出的规则判断。另外会给你工厂与产品资料，用来核对待审文本里的价格、条款、材料、认证等事实；资料本身不是待审对象。
如果待审文本与资料一致、也符合规则，就不要报。对每一个问题：
- 必须写 `rule_id`：只能是下面列出的规则编号之一。
- 必须写 `quote`：从待审文本里逐字复制出有问题的那一小段（不超过 20 个词）。
- 写不出规则编号或原文片段的问题，不要输出。宁可漏报，不要编造。
- severity：red = 明确违反规则；amber = 有风险、需要人确认。
- problem_zh / suggestion_zh 用简体中文，suggestion 给出具体改法。

只输出 JSON：
{"findings": [{"rule_id": "...", "quote": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "problem_zh": "...", "suggestion_zh": "..."}]}
如果没有问题：{"findings": []}

## 平台
阿里巴巴国际站 · RFQ 回复

## 规则
[
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-01",
  "title_zh": "产品属性必须与实物一致",
  "excerpt": "Product attributes must be consistent with the actual condition of the product, and accurately showing the ingredients, materials, sizes, brands, models, places of origin",
  "question_zh": "回复或文案里的材质、尺寸、型号、产地等属性是否与已知产品资料一致（例如是否把塑料手柄/盖子的水壶说成全不锈钢）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-02",
  "title_zh": "付款与发货条件须符合真实能力",
  "excerpt": "Payment and shipping options must be consistent with the actual service capability of suppliers.",
  "question_zh": "回复中承诺的起订量、交期、港口、付款方式或单价，是否都有供应商提供的资料支撑，而不是模型自己编的？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-03",
  "title_zh": "发布的信息须真实、准确、合法",
  "excerpt": "Member should ensure that all information you post on the Sites is true, accurate and lawful and should not be false or misleading",
  "question_zh": "回复中是否有无法由产品资料证实、可能虚假或误导买家的说法（例如未提供证书却声称已获某认证）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-01",
  "title_zh": "FOB / FAS 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both apply only to sea or inland waterway transport (i.e. port-to-to port shipments).",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在空运、快递或陆运场景下使用了 FOB/FAS/CFR/CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-02",
  "title_zh": "集装箱货物更适合用 FCA",
  "excerpt": "FCA (Free Carrier) is the more appropriate Incoterms® rule.",
  "question_zh": "整柜或拼柜的集装箱报价用了 FOB 时，回复是否提示 FCA 可能更合适（可以作为可选项，不要求替换）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-03",
  "title_zh": "FOB：装上买方指定船只即完成交货，风险同时转移",
  "excerpt": "the seller delivers the goods loaded on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复对 FOB 的解释（谁订船、谁付运费、风险何时转移）是否与“装上买方指定船只即交货、风险转移”一致？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-04",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both Incoterms® CIF and Incoterms® CFR are used for sea or inland waterway transportation only.",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在非海运场景下报了 CFR 或 CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-05",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 风险在装运港装船时转移",
  "excerpt": "risk of loss of or damage to the goods transfers when the goods are placed on board the vessel at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复是否错误地表示 CFR/CIF 下卖方要承担运输途中直到目的港的风险？"
 }
]

## 待审文本（按字段）
{
 "reply": "Dear Dana,\n\nThank you for your inquiry and for sharing the details of your project. Placing one steamer in each of 3,200 guest rooms is a clear plan, and we would be glad to support it.\n\nCertification (ETL/UL)\nOur GS-12H handheld steamer does not currently have ETL or UL certification. The unit holds a CB report (IEC 60335-2-3) and CE (LVD/EMC).\n\nWe understand that ETL or UL listing is usually required for hotel use in the US. We can look into ETL or UL certification for the GS-12H. Our team will check the cost and timeline with a testing lab, and I will get back to you with the details. Please also let me know if your group prefers one mark over the other.\n\nQuotation\n- Model: GS-12H Handheld Garment Steamer, 120V 60Hz, 1200W, 260 ml detachable water tank\n- Features: vertical and horizontal steaming, auto shut-off, fabric brush included\n- Price: USD 10.90 per unit, FOB Ningbo, by sea (3,000+ units tier)\n- Packaging: color box, 12 units per carton\n- Standard lead time: about 35 days per production run\n\nAs the goods will likely ship in containers, we can also quote FCA Ningbo if you prefer.\n\nYou mentioned delivery in two lots in Q1. Could you share the planned quantity for each lot? I will then confirm how the 3,000+ pricing applies to your split and suggest a production schedule.\n\nPayment\nL/C at sight is acceptable to us.\n\nSamples\nWe can send 2 samples to your Orlando office. Samples are charged at our factory unit price, and international freight is paid by the buyer. The sample cost can be deducted from your bulk order. If you have a courier account, please share it. Otherwise, I can arrange a freight quote to Orlando.\n\nOther options\n- We can arrange a video factory audit through an Alibaba video call if your team would like to see our production line.\n- We can print your group's logo on the color box free of charge for orders over 1,000 units. A vector file of the logo is required.\n\nPlease confirm the lot quantities, your preferred certification mark, and the sample delivery details, and I will follow up promptly.\n\nBest regards,\nSales Team\nYongjiang Small Appliances"
}
